# Crazy Cattle 3D - Sheep Battle Royale

> A physics-driven battle game where players control explosive sheep and cattle competing for survival across three unique environments.

Crazy Cattle 3D is a fun physics simulation game, available to play online or download, where players can experience the chaotic battles between sheep and cattle herds.

## Core Content
- [Crazy Cattle 3D Home Page](https://cattlecrazy3d.com): Home Page
- [Play Now](https://cattlecrazy3d.com/#game): Experience the complete game directly in your browser
- [Build A Ring Farm](https://cattlecrazy3d.com/build-a-ring-farm): Play a circular farm incremental game with codes, seed tips, and upgrade guide
- [Goal Gang](https://cattlecrazy3d.com/goal-gang): Play chaotic multiplayer football with World Cup 2026 soccer tips
- [Imagine Island](https://cattlecrazy3d.com/imagine-island): Play a virtual island world with monthly events, fishing, fashion, obby, and prop hunt
- [Emoji Guess Master](https://cattlecrazy3d.com/emoji-guess-master): Play the updated emoji puzzle game with answer hints and level keyword guidance
- [Dino World](https://cattlecrazy3d.com/dino-world): Play a new dinosaur squad game with upgrade and beginner strategy tips
- [Captain Blast](https://cattlecrazy3d.com/captain-blast): Play a level-based puzzle adventure with obstacle timing and stage tips
- [Download Game](https://cattlecrazy3d.com/#download): Download the offline version from itch.io
- [Game Features](https://cattlecrazy3d.com/#features): Physics-driven, multiple battle environments, unique characters, and more
- [How to Play](https://cattlecrazy3d.com/#how-to-play): Learn how to control characters and achieve victory
